env.description: Environment the Outline container runs with

URL.description: Public address Outline is reached at, e.g. https://wiki.example.com. Outline checks this is a real URL on startup and refuses to boot if it is empty, and it is also what goes into share links, invite emails and OAuth redirects - so a wrong value gives working pods and broken links

SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts session cookies and stored credentials. The shipped default is a PUBLIC placeholder - generate your own with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Changing it later signs every user out

UTILS_SECRET.description: Authenticates Outline's internal utility endpoints. The shipped default is a PUBLIC placeholder - generate your own with `openssl rand -hex 32`

FORCE_HTTPS.description: Redirect http to https and mark cookies secure. Turn this on once Outline is behind TLS; leaving it on without TLS makes the login loop

image.description: Outline container image, e.g. outlinewiki/outline:0.84. Raising the tag upgrades Outline on the next rollout

nginx.description: nginx Ingress for Outline. Created only when host is set

host.description: Hostname to serve Outline on, e.g. wiki.example.com. Leave empty and no Ingress is created (reach it by port-forwarding the Service instead). Set service.env.URL to match

tlsHost.description: Hostname to put in the TLS certificate. Defaults to the host above; set it only when the certificate is issued for a different name

tlsSecretName.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes TLS secret holding the certificate for that host

minCPU.description: CPU reserved for each Outline pod, e.g. 250m

minMemory.description: Memory reserved for each Outline pod, e.g. 1000Mi. Outline is a Node app and needs roughly 1Gi to start

maxCPU.description: CPU ceiling for each Outline pod, e.g. 500m

maxMemory.description: Memory ceiling for each Outline pod, e.g. 1500Mi

minReplicas.description: Smallest number of Outline pods. Keep at 1 unless the storage below is switched to a ReadWriteMany volume - several pods cannot share a ReadWriteOnce disk

volumeMounts.description: Storage attached to the Outline container

pvc.description: Disks mounted into Outline. The default entry gives /data a 10Gi volume, which is where FILE_STORAGE=local keeps every uploaded image and attachment. Set "storage" to change the size, at install time only - a live volume cannot be resized

postgres.description: Bundled PostgreSQL holding documents, users and collections

diskSize.description: Disk for the bundled PostgreSQL, e.g. 10Gi. Fixed at install time - a live volume cannot be resized afterwards

redis.description: Bundled Redis used for websockets, the job queue and rate limits

diskSize.description: Disk for the bundled Redis, e.g. 10Gi. Fixed at install time - a live volume cannot be resized afterwards
